C1053.title: Unauthorized Physical Access to Smartphones by Insiders
C1053.summary: The MobileHCI 2013 paper Know Your Enemy studies unauthorized access to smartphones by insiders. Based on interviews with 22 participants and a survey of 724 users, the authors found that users are generally concerned about insiders such as friends accessing sensitive data on smartphones, including SMS messages, photos, and email, and concluded that insider threat is a real problem affecting smartphone users.
